idea-plugin.name: Git-Aware Dev Journal
idea-plugin.description:
Git-Aware Dev Journal

IDE-native development journal with deep Git integration. Every note is linked to commit hashes, branches, and code context. Auto-captures entries from conventional commits, generates branch narratives and standup summaries.

Features

  • Journal entries — notes, decisions, TODOs, blockers, insights, questions
  • Git-linked — entries tied to commit hashes, branches, and file positions
  • Auto-capture — parses conventional commits (feat:, fix:, docs:, etc.)
  • Branch narratives — automatic story of work done on a branch
  • Standup generator — "What I did yesterday" from commits + notes (Pro)
  • Timeline view — tool window with filtering, search, and quick entry

Part of Developer Productivity Suite

Works alongside other development tools for comprehensive workflow support.

action.description: Add a development journal entry at the current cursor position
